sup.a1: Use "Stop all" in the top bar, or the "Stop" button next to an account on the dashboard. Stopping a bot does not close open positions — use the open-positions table to close them.
sup.a2: It depends on the symbol's minimum size on Toobit. With 1% risk and an ATR stop-loss, roughly 50 USDT and up is usually workable — but always test in paper mode first.
sup.a3: Keys are stored only in config/accounts.json on your own server. On Toobit, grant the key Trade permission only and leave Withdraw disabled. Restricting by IP is also recommended.
sup.a4: Copy the webhook URL and the sample JSON message from the Settings page and paste them into your TradingView alert. Enable the webhook option on each account.
